director.name: 维托里奥·卡奇那 Vittorio Calcina

introduction: TURIN EXPO 18981st May 1898. Inauguration of the Italian National Exhibition in the presence of King Umberto I and Queen Margherita. The Parco del Valentino becomes a theater of evocative outdoor landscapes, a kind of city of wonders, of progress and innovation. The film is divided into three parts:The first part shows the inauguration of the National Exposition in the presence of King Umberto I and Queen Margherita (1 May 1898). The Parco del Valentino is transformed into a theater of evoking landscapes, into a wonderland of progress and innovation. (00:00)The second part consists of still frames portraying the Exposition through photographs and illustrations of the time. It can be seen, for example, the former Palazzo di Città, Piazza Vittorio Veneto and the Porta Nuova railway station. (06:30)The third part displays parades and street scenes of Rome: Piazza del Popolo, the Colle del Quirinale and Piazza Risorgimento. (14:06)The video is a copy from a fragment of the film print held by the Museo Nazionale del Cinema: 35mm, positive, acetate, 147 m, black and white, silent.—Cineteca di Bologna
